scope: Versioned single-hit damage from catalog parameters and explicit combat facts. This record does not claim automatic action scheduling, resource feasibility or game damage observations.

states.meaning: One explicit state: none, stellar-conduct or stellar-swirl. No simultaneous Radiance states or default active state.
Whether the owner is in the skill stance at the requested phase.

Explicit count from 0 to 6 at the read time. Each source stack lasts 20 seconds; entering the skill or leaving the field clears it. C2 grants maximum stacks when entering the stance after A1 is unlocked.
Explicit availability within five seconds after a highest-stage special skill. The output separately checks constellation 6.

bindingRules: Original normal hit identities stay physical outside the stance; explicit .anemo variants use the same parameters inside it.
Skill parameters 4/6/8 and burst parameter 1 use ordinary damage outside Stellar Swirl Radiance; 5/7/9 and burst parameter 2 use direct Stellar Swirl damage inside it.
Each request denotes one damage segment. The two hits of normal attack 3 and four intermediate third-stage spirit hits require separate explicit occurrences.
A1 multiplies only spirit skill bases. Its ordinary and Stellar Swirl targets remain separate; reaction-specific flat additions stay after the reaction and mastery factors.
A4 counts current party members from their supplied elemental identities, including the owner. Missing identities stay unknown.
C2 attack requires A1 and six known stacks. C4 replaces the A4 rates with triple values; it does not add the original rates again.
The no-ascension linchpin passive applies its attack-based base bonus to the supplied party. It has no invented breakthrough requirement.
C6 slash and spirit ratios come from the constellation description, with a distinct window and constellation guard. C6 elevation applies only to Stellar Swirl damage.
No ordinary damage bonus, defense factor or level multiplier is inherited by direct Stellar Swirl outputs.
Declared state facts supply single-hit conditions. Their history, skill resources, cancellation and automatic scheduling remain separate action work.
